description: Create a comment→DM automation. Once created it is LIVE and will DM real people automatically, so show the user the exact dmMessage, keywords and which account it runs on, and get their approval first. Use an accountId from list_comment_automations. Instagram and Facebook only.

alsoMatchInDms.description: Also match incoming DM keywords; comment trigger and non-empty keywords required.

buttons.description: URL buttons; messages with buttons allow 640 characters. Show destinations before creating.

clickTag.description: Tag contacts who click a tracked URL button; empty clears.

commentReply.description: Optional PUBLIC reply posted under the comment as well

dmMessage.description: The DM sent to whoever triggers the automation

followersOnly.description: Explicitly restrict Instagram comment buttons to known followers. Non-followers and unknowns are skipped; use plain text to reach them.

keywords.description: Words that trigger it (max 25). Leave empty to fire on every comment

linkTracking.description: Track clicks on links in the DM

matchMode.description: exact: the comment must be exactly the keyword. contains: the keyword appears anywhere

name.description: Internal name for the automation (not shown to the public)

platformPostId.description: Restrict to one post (platform id). Omit to run account-wide on every post

postTitle.description: Human-readable label for the post it is restricted to

trigger.description: comment: fires on post comments. story_reply: fires on story replies

name: create_comment_automation
title: Create Comment Automation
